name: torch-linear-demo
notes: The tier-2 torch pack, end to end on the synthetic market: SynthEvents quotes a mid that under-reacts to p_true, LinearRegressor learns the correction (features/label are row keys), and LinearPredictor restores the SAME fit from the saved artifact via the artifact_path wire — no registration needed, packs are referenced by import path. The loader block is the docs/24 §3 convention, default-deny inside (I-227).

market.notes: deterministic settled events; every row carries mid and p_true

qhat.notes: one nn.Linear over the features; the seed pins init + shuffle, so this fit is byte-reproducible and the artifact records the seed

predict.notes: inference-only: REALLY loads the state_dict qhat saved (sidecar-verified: content hash + module class), never refits
